files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
Several tag questions per mapping. Additive: the legacy single `tag_question_id` keeps tagging an
unmodified pre-0.6.0 mapping, so nothing needs re-saving and no card/form data is touched.

### Added

- **Tags from more than one choice question.** The mapping editor's tag picker is now a multi-select;
  at submission time the answers of every selected dropdown / multiple-choice question are matched
  (trimmed, case-insensitively) against the board's existing Deck labels and the **union** of matches
  is assigned, each label at most once. Labels are still never created by the app, and an unmatched
  answer only logs (`DECISIONS.md` §18).
- **`forms_deck_mapping_tag_questions`** (one row per mapping+question) and
  `GET /apps/forms_deck/mappings` now returns the resolved `tagQuestionIds` list alongside the legacy
  `tagQuestionId`; `MappingController` accepts `tagQuestionIds` on create/update.
- A second finite-choice question, an answer for it, and a duplicate-label assertion in the e2e
  harness, which now covers the union **and** the dedup case (criterion 12).

### Changed

- `CardFactory::assignTags()` reads the side table (falling back to `tag_question_id`) and assigns
  the union of all matches; a side-table read failure only logs, like every other tag failure — it
  never marks a created card as a mapping error.

### Notes

- The migration `Version010500Date20261001120000` only **creates a table**, so it is safe to run
  before the PHP opcache is reset even though the server runs with
  `opcache.validate_timestamps=0`. A new column on `forms_deck_mappings` deliberately was not used:
  `MappingMapper` hydrates with `SELECT *`, so old cached code would fatal on an unknown column
  (the 0.5.0 incident). See `DECISIONS.md` §18.
